05/31/2006: Station Maintenance: (bn): 
 
            - General Station Maintenance and System Checks: 
                 - weed removal and application of Round-Up above soil temps

                 - anemometer bearings checked

                   replaced. 
                       
            - Work was done approx: 15:10 - 15:40 (Day=151) 
 
 
05/22/2006: Station Maintenance (sm): 
 
            - The datalogger for the Constantine MAWN station malfunctioned 
              over the weekend.   The reason for the failure is unknown, but 
              this morning, the data collection program (mawn1c) needed to  
              be reinstalled (uploaded).  This was done at 9:00am and once 
              again, data is being recorded.   However, the recent troubles 
              did lead to a loss of data - there is no data for the Constantine 
              MAWN station during the following time period: 
 
                 05/20/06 05:10  -  05/22/06 09:00

08/19/2004: Station Maintenance (jal): 
 
            - Replaced Pyranometer (Solar Radiation Sensor) 
 
 
04/14/2004: Data Logger Maintenance (crn, sm): 
 
            - Faulty CR10X Datalogger temporarily replaced 
              with CR10.  Will be replaced with a new CR10X 
              after next hardware order.  (approx 11:30am). 
 
            - Lightning Surge Protection Upgraded. 
 
 
04/07/2004: Data Logger Maintenance (jtb): 
 
            - Datalogger error (E08) codes were reading 99.   
              Counters were reset back to 00.  This action  
              will hopefully resolve and/or prevent brief  
              data outages observed on some data loggers  
              when the error count reaches 99.  
 
 
01/02/2004: Station Repair (crn) 
 
            - Incomplete data collection over the past several weeks led  
              to replacement of the data logger.  Tests indicate the power 
              supply is fine.  Data logger was replaced around 12:00pm. 
 
            - Replaced the following: 
                 Data Logger (CR10X):     Serial #: X ????? 
 
            - Data between the following dates is incomplete and Daily 
              values may be inaccurate due to gaps in data: 
 
                 Dec 22, 2003 (Day=356)  thru  Feb 02, 2004 (Day=002)
